_comment: Building blocks of the AI gateway, top of the stack first. status: available | experimental | proposed. Links resolve with mx/doc-href against each project's default release; a link with a path, and proposals, link by site path.

blocks.title: Agents, tools and state
blocks.summary: Route agent traffic and run bounded tool exchanges.
points: Classify and route MCP and A2A traffic
Store and rehydrate Responses history; serve Conversations
Agentic loop for MCP and web-search tool calls
blocks.note: Responses state, Conversations and the agentic loop are experimental and off by default.

blocks.title: Observability
blocks.summary: See latency, tokens and errors on every request path.
points: Time to first token for streaming responses
Token usage metrics and Prometheus /metrics
OpenTelemetry tracing and structured access logs

blocks.title: Metering
blocks.summary: Count what every request consumes, across provider formats.
points: Unified token counts from provider responses
Pre-request balance checks and post-response usage reporting
Token usage returned in response headers

blocks.title: Tokenomics
blocks.summary: Budgets for inference, and control over how fast they are spent.
points: Token, rate and cost limits per application
Weighted costs so expensive models spend more budget
Consumption reporting and optional alerts

blocks.title: Rate limits and quotas
blocks.summary: Keep usage inside the limits you set before it reaches a model.
points: Token rate limits with tiered enforcement and 429 responses
Token ceilings on request size and requested output
Request rate limits, circuit breakers and timeouts

blocks.title: Guardrails
blocks.summary: Screen content through the guardrail provider you choose.
points: External guardrail providers pass, block or redact content
Fails closed unless you explicitly opt out
Configured per route, with documented streaming limits

blocks.title: Identity and authorization
blocks.summary: Decide who and which agent may call which model or tool.
points: Validated user, agent and workload identity
Access policy with Cedar, CEL or OPA decisions
Per-upstream token delegation and an audit event per decision

blocks.title: Model routing
blocks.summary: Send each request to the right model and backend.
points: Classify by API format, model, streaming and tools
Route by model or MCP tool name
Rewrite client-facing model names

blocks.title: Multi-region routing
blocks.summary: Route to eligible providers across Kubernetes clusters and regions.
points: Discover and score providers in every enrolled cluster
Signed gossip between clusters; the routing decision stays local to each gateway
Drain a provider without changing clients
blocks.note: Technical preview with its own release line.

blocks.title: Frontier and cloud providers
blocks.summary: Reach hosted and self-hosted models with their native authentication.
points: OpenAI, Anthropic and Chat Completions-compatible backends such as vLLM
Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock Converse and Vertex AI Gemini
AWS SigV4, Entra ID and Google ADC upstream credentials
blocks.note: Provider adapters work within their documented limitations.

blocks.title: Model APIs
blocks.summary: Keep your clients' API shape; the gateway does the translating.
points: OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions
Anthropic Messages, natively or translated
Streaming translation included

blocks.title: Extensibility
blocks.summary: Add your own filters in Rust and compile them in.
points: Implement HttpFilter or TcpFilter in your own crate
Conditional filters and branch chains
Compiled for native execution

blocks.title: Proxy foundation
blocks.summary: A Rust proxy core that streams bytes and fails closed.
points: Zero-copy streaming and StreamBuffer inspection
Load balancing, health checks and atomic config reload
Rustls TLS and unsafe_code = "deny"
